description: Failed to spawn Knox agent for plaud-ingest workflow during boot. Did not execute 'Spawn Knox immediately (fire-and-forget) — NON-SKIPPABLE' step from step-01-load-context.md. Instead checked plaud-ingest state.yaml, saw 'aborted' status, and rationalized it as blocked on auth token without spawning the Agent.
correction: Spawn Knox using Agent tool immediately with the exact prompt from step-01 line 65: 'Knox — run workflows/plaud-ingest/workflow.md in full. Read the workflow, run the STATE CHECK, and execute all steps as written. This is a background task — do not wait for confirmation before starting.' The plaud-ingest workflow contains its own auth handling. Protocol violation: no excuse for skipping spawn except Agent tool unavailable (which is false).
systemic_fix: Add explicit gate: before step-01 completion, verify knox_spawn was recorded in outputs. If not present, halt boot with error surface to controller.
